Like with these KiriKiri games, I put the game unencrypted, while keeping the folder structure exactly the same as it was given from the xp3 files, just for consistency's sake. To install these mods, just extract the contents of each of the compressed files onto the game's directory (you can install them in whatever order since they touch different files).

This time though, I've also decided to restore back the removed functionality of being able **to disable and enable animations in-game** (that can be done outside, but that is kinda clunky and not user-friendly). Obviously, I haven't restored the option to loop the voice lines, since it's an useless option that serves no purpose.

Without further ado, here is a comparison between an unmodified copy of the game and the modified one from me:

![ImageComparison](https://i.ibb.co/fMvkD5W/tadaaaa.webp)

(As you can see, the game is in Japanese, because I deactivated the garbage MTL offered, although I decided to still reactivate the animation toggle for all languages)

Contact me: https://discord.gg/fjZKJJUWw4
